info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Galena Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Galena Syrup Catalog Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage and update the details of Galena syrup products in their catalog. This API allows users to create comprehensive entries for each syrup variant, ensuring accurate representation and availability of product information. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms, inventory management systems, and retail applications that require detailed product catalogs. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline the process of catalog updates, ensuring that product offerings are current and meet market demands.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create and store details for Galena Syrup. Provide the necessary information in the request body to successfully add new details to the database.

requestBody.description: Contains the details required to create or update galena syrup information. This request body should be formatted as a JSON object including all necessary fields as defined in the schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested details.

galena_syrup_id.description: The unique identifier for the Galena syrup.

requestedBy.description: The name of the individual or entity requesting the Galena syrup.

quantity.description: The quantity of Galena syrup being requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority request.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Galena syrup.
